citation.authors: Zilstorff DB, Richter MM, Hannibal J, et al.
citation.title: Secretion of glucagon, GLP-1 and GIP may be affected by circadian rhythm in healthy males

population.description: 24 healthy men, inclusion age 18-45 y, BMI 18.5-24.9 kg/m2 (enrolment criteria; observed min/max not reported). Age and BMI mean ± SD from Table 1. The 09:00 fasting values are from 22 men: two subjects had not fasted overnight and their 09:00 samples were excluded (Table 2 footnote N = 22 for the first timepoint).

protocols.name: day24
protocols.description: Hospital ward, arrive 08:00 after an overnight fast (fasting from 22:00, 10 h at arrival); first blood sample 09:00 (minute 60, fasted 11 h) before breakfast at 09:30; arm ends after that sample
